{{Top|leg}}
'''Wilderness Road''' was a crude roadway that permitted access and exit from the [[Mining/Legends|mining]] boom-town of [[Roaring Crater]]. It led to the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler's]] landing pad located several miles away.<ref name="J15">{{JournalCite|15|Tasariq: The Crystal Planet}}</ref>
